chapter.heading: Announcement of the Messiah’s ReignA Psalm of David.
chapter.v:
The Lord
said to my Lord,“Sit at My right hand,Till I make Your enemies Your footstool.”

The Lord
shall send the rod of Your strength out of Zion.Rule in the midst of Your enemies! [Is. 60:3 b Ps. 5; 148:11, 13 c Is.]

Your people
shall be volunteersIn the day of Your power;In the beauties of holiness, from the womb of the morning,You have the dew of Your youth. [Is. 28:5; Zech. 9:16; 1 Thess. 2:19]

The Lord
has swornAnd will not relent,“You are a priest foreverAccording to the order of Melchizedek.” [Is. 54:1] [Hos. 1:10; 1 Pet. 2:10 f Is.]

The Lord
is at Your right hand;He shall execute kings in the day of His wrath. [Is. 65:19]

He shall
judge among the nations,He shall fill the places with dead bodies,He shall execute the heads of many countries. [Is. 52:8; Jer. 6:17; Ezek. 3:17;]

He shall
drink of the brook by the wayside;Therefore He shall lift up the head. [Is. 60:18; 61:11; Jer. 33:9; Zeph.]
